archive_note: Historical phase-1 plan retained as provenance. Its pre-canonical module names are not runtime contracts; current ledger runtime uses ConfigurableLedgerService and JdbcOperationalStore.
objective: 将全局台账完成标记改造成按学校、食堂、周期隔离且可恢复的后端模块

included: business requirements catalog and backend service boundary
scoped ledger cycle domain and application port
Flyway V2 migration for school/canteen/cycle/requirement/alert tables
REST v1 cycle start, record completion and current alert query
domain, HTTP, H2 restart and MySQL concurrency tests
deferred: device, district platform and procurement third-party adapters

module.database_identity: 复合主键 (school_id, canteen_id, cycle_id)，允许不同学校/食堂复用相同周期编号
module.master_data_bootstrap: 本阶段适配器为测试/切片自动补齐学校和食堂；正式系统由基础资料模块提供目录端口

state_machine.completion: PENDING -> COMPLETED; repeated COMPLETED completion is a no-op
state_machine.alert: OPEN while missingLedgerCodes is non-empty, otherwise CLEARED
